title: Track last successful remote observation separately from worker lease
summary: Add a fenced SQLite last-success heartbeat for read-only GitHub observer and a host-local read-only freshness probe. A fresh lease with stale or failed remote observations no longer qualifies as recent local evidence. No persistent host was deployed.
migration_notes: Additive worker_observation_health SQLite table only, created by existing WorkerLease initialization. No destructive migration, existing journal intact. Existing deployed worker host is not independently verified.
